subject: Information Theory
title: Entropy and Ecology
description: A fast breakdown of Entropy and Ecology for builders.

hook.text: A forest with 50 species has higher diversity than one with 3. Ecologists measure this with Shannon entropy.

buildup.text: Shannon diversity index: H = -Σ pᵢ log pᵢ, where pᵢ is each species' proportion. Same formula, different domain.

discovery.text: A forest where one species dominates has low entropy. An even mix of many species has high entropy.

twist.text: High diversity (high entropy) ecosystems are more resilient. The redundancy buffers against shocks.

climax.text: Shannon's formula traveled from phone lines to rainforests. Math doesn't care what the symbols represent.

punchline.text: Same formula measures message surprise and forest diversity.

quiz.question: How do ecologists use Shannon entropy?
